name: The first blade (n0)
desc: The game before the layer that does not end. Kept as it was.

name: The transformation of things (n1)
desc: n0 plus the three tracks that do not end: forms and rings (the flower becomes the acorn), the forest that every ring plants and nothing takes away, and the mycelium under it all, fed by rot and tribute, a thousandfold deeper each step.

name: The ten thousand things (n5)
desc: A candidate. Seeds, mist, clay, resin, jade, honey and moss on top of the n0 chains; seasons; water that must be held; seed that rots; 24 chapters; 36 sayings with two paths that exclude each other; 8 guests; 7 things to keep at the root. Heavier by five turns of the screw. On the maybe list until it has been played.
